sections.label: The opening
sections.para: The workflow that built a talk in a day can present each build-day project: story, infographics, the app and sourced numbers; it shows the power of agentic workflows and is a finite service.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: The ask; the pieces exist; the workflow; one prompt; the demonstration; the service; how we recommend build days.

sections.label: The suggestion
sections.para: A participant asked for a quick presentation of each project; the editor replied with the talk's presentation as the model.

sections.label: We already have every piece
sections.para: The ultimate insider was built in a day by nine agents and one editor, with a site and moving infographics; the book we are writing explains the workflow.

sections.label: What one prompt already does
sections.para: ChatGPT made two infographics of today's six articles: imperfect, and a good picture of what good material allows.

sections.label: A presentation for every project
sections.para: The project, a repository, an agent team that checks, draws and writes, a presentation site, and sharing: by the show and tell or overnight.

sections.line: It shows the power of agentic workflows

sections.label: And it is a service

sections.label: How we recommend running build days
sections.line: How we recommend running build days
